user.title: Connect to a BleBox device
user.description: Enter the address of the BleBox device whose physical buttons should be usable in Home Assistant. Relays, power and energy stay with the official BleBox integration.

data_description.host: The device's address on your network, for example 192.168.1.100.
data_description.port: Leave at 80 unless the device is reachable on another port.

discovery_confirm.title: Add button events
discovery_confirm.description:
Add physical button events for **{name}** ({model}) at {host}?

Detected physical inputs: **{inputs}**

inputs.title: Physical inputs
inputs.description: **{name}** did not report its physical inputs, so they cannot be detected automatically. Enter how many the device has; you can change this later by re-adding the device.

events.title: Choose button events
events.description:
Select the events **{name}** should send to Home Assistant for each physical input.

**Automatic** programs the device itself and never modifies actions you configured yourself. **Manual** shows the URLs to paste into the wBox app.

Free action slots on the device: **{available}**

data.base_url: Home Assistant URL for the device to call

data_description.base_url: Must be reachable from the device's network. Leave as detected unless the device sits on a separate VLAN.

manual.title: Configure these URLs on the device

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the device. Check the address and that Home Assistant can route to the device's network.
error.no_events: Select at least one event on at least one input.
error.no_url: Home Assistant could not work out a URL for the device to call. Enter one manually.
error.insufficient_slots: The device does not have enough free action slots for the selected events. Free some in the wBox app, select fewer events, or choose manual configuration.

abort.already_configured: Button events are already set up for this device.
abort.no_inputs: This device does not report any physical inputs, so it has no button events to add.

events.title: Button events
events.description: Select the events each physical input should send to Home Assistant.

data.base_url: Home Assistant URL for the device to call

data_description.base_url: Must be reachable from the device's network.

data.cleanup_on_remove: Remove this integration's actions from the device when deleting it
data.push_relay_state: Report relay state from the device
data.manage_buttons: Let Home Assistant change what buttons do

data_description.debounce_ms: Ignores an identical event repeated within this window, which absorbs device retries. Set to 0 to disable.
data_description.invert_edges: Enable if 'pressed' and 'released' arrive the wrong way round for how the input is wired.
data_description.cleanup_on_remove: Only actions created by this integration are ever removed.
data_description.push_relay_state: Adds a relay switch fed by the device's own periodic reports. This duplicates the official BleBox integration's switch and uses one action slot; the device cannot report on change, only on a timer.
data_description.push_interval_s: How often the device reports its relay state. Shorter means more traffic for no extra accuracy between reports.
data_description.manage_buttons: Adds a control per button to set what it does to the relay locally. This edits actions you configured yourself, which the integration otherwise never touches. Actions of a type it does not understand are always left alone.

callbacks_unreachable.title: {name} cannot reach Home Assistant
callbacks_unreachable.description:
The switch is firing its callbacks but no HTTP response is coming back, so button presses never arrive. This is a network path problem between the device and Home Assistant — typically a firewall rule missing in the device-to-Home-Assistant direction, or the configured Home Assistant URL not being reachable from the device's network.

Device: {host}

callbacks_rejected.title: {name} is reaching Home Assistant but being rejected
callbacks_rejected.description: The switch reaches Home Assistant, which answers with HTTP {status}. The network path is fine; the callback URL is wrong. Re-copy the URLs from the integration's options and reconfigure them on the device.
